summary: Metals Royalty Co Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a definitive agreement to acquire a 1.0% index-priced gross overriding production royalty (with revenue floor) on the Mesabi Metallics iron ore project for $132.5 million. The transaction is financed via a $75 million PIPE priced at $13.00/share (including $15M from insiders) and up to $50 million senior secured credit facility. First production is targeted for H2 2026. The board recommends the acquisition; no advisor named. The royalty covers production up to 8.5 Mtpa on a 23+ year mine life. Watch for regulatory clearance and project ramp timeline.
